steps.name: Finally entered
steps.objective: Go to “Lu Man Union Headquarters” and find [Yu Lan].

steps.name: urgent mind
steps.objective: After talking with [Yuran] at the “Luman Union Headquarters”, go to [Xerix].

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: %s, I've been waiting for you. My name is Yuran, and I am a disciple of my teacher, Jiscard. Hey %s, are you okay? I think you're a little tired... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, Iris… . Where is Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I ran for a long time to meet Iris... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'm sorry to say this. Iris is not at the Federation Headquarters right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What do you mean by that?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I have a situation right now. Could you please wait a moment? I'll be able to meet you soon... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I understand your disappointment, but now Iris is also preparing as Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I ask what you are preparing?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Iris went to the Forest of Water Lily. I am training there. Making the power you gain your own... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, if you go to the Forest of Water Lily, you can meet Iris?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: If you really want to do that, go to the Forest of Water Lily. However, the road ahead will not be easy.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Hehe, so what do you want to do most when you meet Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First of all, I want to ask how you are.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: … It's a surprisingly obvious greeting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm worried about what to say to Iris. I don't know what Iris will tell me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I talked to myself for a long time. sorry. Oh, by the way, how do I get to the Water Lily Forest?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Xerix will kindly tell you about the Forest of Training. The person in white over there... . You're already gone.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: (I can only hope that I am not the wrong person...)

steps.name: Whereabouts of Iris
steps.objective: After talking with [Xerix] at the “Luman Union Headquarters”, go to [Jin].

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: What are you? This is my first time seeing it… . If the barrier had been opened and entry was made, there must have been Jiscard's permission. Then it would be Adventurer that Iris was talking about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer is exactly what Iris said. Where is Iris now? And, and… .

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: It's frustrating. Iris To meet you, you have to go to the training ground. First, go and get permission to enter from Jin.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: Then it's over.  Don't make me go through this trouble anymore.

lines.speaker: 제릭스
lines.text: What should I do if I don't go? I was so busy that I made time to deal with him like this... .  Jin is over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. I'll go right away. Thank you, Xerix.

steps.name: Entrance to the Forest of Water Lily
steps.objective: Enter the “Forest of Training” and kill [Secret Forest Summoner] and [Noblesse Changryongdae], then go to [Sugar].

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Xerix’s voice is loud. I heard the whole story. Looking for Iris... . He went to the training ground, but I think he would be on the floating island by now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A floating island? How can I get there?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: There is a path inside, so go there. Instead, there is something to be careful about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is a place to practice, so is there a need to be careful?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: I'm saying this because I don't know anything. It is a place prepared for warriors, and it is a place with some kind of rules.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so? I want to go and learn the rules... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because I'm in a hurry. Could you please give me a permit?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Then there is nothing we can do. Experience the inside and learn the rules there. It won't be a bad experience. If only you can hold out long enough... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What does that mean... .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Now, I allow you to go to the training ground. You can go in now. I hope you can endure all the trials there and come back as a truly skilled person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thank you!

steps.name: There are no exceptions.
steps.objective: Defeat [Screaming Face of Death] and [Flame Hell Cowl].

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Does Adventurer, who came this far, come to meet Iris? I guess you want to go even deeper. Hehe… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Have you heard my story?

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: That's right. Iris said so.  Adventurer If someone visits, please talk to them kindly.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work getting here, but rules are rules so please follow what I say. Iris Even if you are the person you mentioned, this is a forest of water lilies.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: First, prove yourself here.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Like Adventurer, people from various guilds are here to prove themselves. Well then, please go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will try.

steps.name: Floating Island Manager, Bilbrat
steps.objective: After talking with [Sugar], enter the floating island and fight and win against [Athenian Assassin], [Secret Forest Warrior], and [Bilbrat]. Then report the quest to [Bilbrat].

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: You are here. I was waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, this is the rule that Jin was talking about. Fighting and winning in the forest of water lilies... .

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Yes, that is the rule of this forest of training. The Deimos Church that is disturbing the continent, demons and demons that target humans, including Iris... .

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: In addition, Jiscard created this space to protect the world full of unknown threats.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: So many warriors were produced and were able to fight against evil for a long time. I've seen such warriors, but I think Adventurer is a bit special.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Maybe you could become like Jis Card, who is called the Sword God. Even now, many people dream of becoming a swordsman and are training hard, but what will happen? Hehe… .

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: To do that, there are a lot of things you have to go through. Skill is good, but you also have to have luck.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: The story is long. Iris I was going to talk about you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'll focus. So please continue.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: I am a wizard, a person who does a slightly different type of work than a member of a religious order that believes in God. So, I might speak a little bad about Iris.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: I will ask for your understanding in advance about that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's okay. I know very well that you are thinking of Iris when you say that.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Thank you for your understanding. Then I will continue the story.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Iris You were born as a human being, not a god... . He sensed the demon lord and defeated him, but he realized that his choice was something different.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: You were stuck in a place you may or may not have wanted to be. Then someone called Iris and I was able to get out of there.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: And as you know, Adventurer, the rest were qualified by obtaining the power of Ceres at the Ceres Temple.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: In order to truly accept that qualification and become a goddess, you must continue to train. You must make that power your own and use it entirely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, Suga, do you know where Iris was?

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Huh? What did I just say? uh? what? For a moment, I felt like it wasn't me... .  When you're in the forest of water lilies, various things can happen, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The air here feels strangely strange, are you really okay?

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: I'm fine. So please continue to practice hard. Oh, Iris has gone to the floating island, so you will be able to meet him.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Hurry up and go. And please say hello to Wilbrarat.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, yes. I'll give it a go first, but still... . Then I'll really go. Thank you.

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: (Sugar stares at the back of %s heading towards the inside of the floating island and sighs.)

lines.speaker: 슈가
lines.text: Hehe, I told you you shouldn't come here often. Iris Even if you said you were worried, it would be troublesome if you did this.

steps.name: I Muwen
steps.objective: In “Illusionary Poison Mist Swamp”, defeat [Executing Arc Grim Reaper], [Battle Knight Dealer], and [Nightmare of Iris] and meet Muwen.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: Is it because it’s been a while since I lost? I was speechless for a moment. and… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I've seen many reactions, but this is my first time seeing this kind of reaction, so I'm embarrassed.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: I won't say much. Since you lost, do whatever you want. I originally set the rules here, but since you won, I'll make them special.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay because I haven't thought about that. I came here because I thought I could meet Iris. Oh, and Suga wanted to say hello.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: How are you… . We had a meal together yesterday too... . Ah, Iris? Iris Are you talking about your sister?

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: Ho, you are the one who came to see Iris sister… . I heard a story about something you saw in a dream, and I think you're right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Dream… Iris was watching me in my dream.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Where is Iris now? I heard it was here... .

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: Set the rules first. Then I'll tell you. Even if you don't have any feelings, decide on anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, I can't help it. Whenever I have time, I go around the floating island and clean it. It's messy because it's written in a disorganized manner by various guilds.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: Ugh, there are kids who do that separately… . Heh, I'll do it. You can do it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now tell me where Iris is.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: My sister went to the Poison Fog Swamp. I thought it would be better to train in the Poison Fog Swamp rather than on a floating island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: Yes, poison fog swamp.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: There, weaknesses and things that need to be overcome appear as illusions. If you can defeat that illusion, you can overcome everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What does Iris have to overcome?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to meet up and talk first.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: Iris My sister continues to hold on there. I want to overcome my weaknesses, but it doesn't seem to be easy.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: It's not the first time I've taken someone who passed out at the entrance.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: Take good care of me. So that human life is not lonely... . And if you become a goddess, you might become even more lonely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… , Iris should be happy. Because that's who he has to be. Thanks, I'll go then.

lines.speaker: 빌브라트
lines.text: Oh, that's right. I was going to say it was just as dangerous there... . Hey, I guess you’ll figure it out… .

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: %s? %s, right? Have you come this far? really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me, that's right. It's been a long time since we last met. Muwen, nice to meet you. How have you been? How did you come to Eastland? I, I… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A lot happened. Let’s take it slow and talk about what happened so far… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How are you here now?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Me and Zoe have been looking for Iris for a long time. In the meantime, %s, I've been to where you were, but it seems like our paths diverged.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Then we heard a rumor and came all the way here in search of Iris. There were all kinds of coincidences, but this must all be the guidance of the Goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But is there only Muwen here now? I heard there were others, where have they gone?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: I don't know. First of all, according to Jiscard, we are here helping with the training of Iris. If Iris faints, all you have to do is hurry and take him outside... .

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Master Velosh disappeared somewhere, and Master Frozen went north. They say we need to find out what the Deimos Church is doing... .

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Other people came out to support Eastland as various things happened.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Ah, this is not a problem now! I was so happy to see you after such a long time that I forgot... .

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Iris is dangerous. If you leave it alone, you will be caught up in the darkness inside you again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: In the Poison Fog Swamp, you can see weaknesses and things that can be overcome, but it becomes increasingly scary.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: If you don't overcome it, it will erode. Just as no matter how hard a rock is, it gets chipped away by the waves. Yuran said that every time you fail to defeat it, it becomes more dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what is Iris fighting?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: It's the devil... . Iris's fear, the devil. He is afraid that his choice, which he believed was right, led to a different outcome.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: We think the choice of Iris was the best... . It's a fate too harsh for Iris. Sometimes, I want to blame myself when things like this happen. No matter who the target is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I understand that a little bit. Iris is… .

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Ah, %s. We shouldn't be doing this now. Sorry for the long talk.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Go help Iris.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: I will be here preventing the nightmares that contain those memories from coming. Because I want to help Iris in a country like this. Come on, come on!

steps.name: Runaway
steps.objective: Defeat [Illusion of the Demon King] and meet [Zoe] and [Iris].

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Iris, Iris. Please listen to me. If you keep doing this, you'll be in big trouble. What did I say please? Think about your body too!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: A little!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A little! Is this Zoe voice, Zoe? Zoe Are you there?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: %s, %s, correct? What's going on here? Ah, this is it. That's what's important now! No matter what I say, Iris won't wake up, as if my ears are blocked!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris? But why Iris? Ah, erosion!! Iris, it’s dangerous!! wake up!! Wake up!! Now, wait… . What is that thing that appears before my eyes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Demon King… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel scared, scared, and want to run away. Iris, Iris, have you been holding on to all of these feelings until now?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Iris, hold on. It will be over in just a moment. I'll show you that your choice is not wrong... . Just be patient.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, wake up!! I came. So wake up from this fear.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Choen, Kazno… . I trusted you... .  Don't do this... . I, I… . I didn't want to do this... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please… . Please, my choice is… . What I believed was… . Aaaaaaaaa!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, Iris!! Come to your senses!! Iris!! Iris!! Come to your senses!! please!! It won't work. I need to get him out quickly. however… . Why is Wool here?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I came to pick up Iris by Master's order. So back off.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if it doesn't?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Well, there's nothing you can do. Fall asleep... .
